query:
UPDATE users u
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT organizationId, MIN(id) as first_user_id
  FROM users
  GROUP BY organizationId
) first_users ON u.id = first_users.first_user_id
SET u.isPrimaryAdmin = 1
WHERE u.isPrimaryAdmin = 0;
